title: About Me
text:
I’m originally from Manta Potrero, a small town in Paraguay. I began my agricultural career at the San Francisco Agricultural School in Cerrito, Paraguay. Since then, I have earned degrees from EARTH University in Costa Rica, UnADM in Mexico (On-line), and Kansas State University in the United States. Along this journey, I have learned from and contributed to a variety of agricultural projects across regions.

📊 Postdoctoral Research Associate (Sep 2026 – Present)
- Advise on statistical analysis and the selection of appropriate methods for research projects across diverse areas of agriculture.

Analyze and interpret complex datasets using applied statistics, statistical modeling, and programming to support research and decision-making.
Evaluate model performance and synthesize evidence across experiments to develop data-driven recommendations.
Support the planning and development of research projects, contributing to scientific publications, technical reports, and communication of results to researchers and agricultural professionals.












🧪 Graduate Research Assistant (Jan 2021 – Aug 2026)
- Led multidisciplinary research on phosphorus (P) and sulfur (S) management, including P correlation and calibration, residual P effects, long-term P placement, and P and S interactions.

Established and managed more than 50 site-years across corn, soybean, wheat, and sorghum in collaboration with farmers and university extension programs; supervised student interns and coordinated field research activities.
Designed experiments and analyzed multi-site and multi-environment datasets using statistical modeling to evaluate crop responses, treatment effects, and nutrient management strategies.
Developed reproducible statistical analyses and data visualizations for scientific publications, technical reports, and presentations at professional conferences.












🔬 Research Assistant (Jul 2019 – Dec 2020)
- Assisted in setting up and maintaining fertility trials, testing company products, and overseeing greenhouse studies, including sulfur and nitrogen use with N15 isotope tracers.

Managed sample handling and processing, ensuring accuracy and consistency in data collection.
Operated and maintained research equipment, including planting, tractor operations, fertilizer, and herbicide application.















🐖 Production Intern (Ohio International Intern Program) (May 2018 – Apr 2019)
- Supported daily swine production operations, health monitoring, and facility upkeep.
- Assisted with artificial insemination and farrowing, enhancing animal care protocols.
- Recorded growth data to support better farm management and animal welfare practices.












🌞 Undergraduate Research Assistant, CIDER (Jan 2017 – Dec 2017)
- Developed renewable energy projects: biodigesters, solar cooking, desalination, and pumping.
- Conducted biodigester research and organized outreach workshops.
- Collaborated on sustainable energy systems for rural communities.












☕ Student Intern (SEPS Project) (Aug 2016 – Dec 2016)
- Evaluated biodigester biosolids as fertilizer for coffee nurseries.
- Installed clean-energy systems and trained rural communities in their use.
- Designed and built gasification units for biochar and energy production.

title: Gustavo Roa
text:
I’m Gustavo Roa, a Postdoctoral Researcher in Agronomy at Kansas State University, specializing in soil fertility, nutrient management, and nutrient use efficiency. My work combines field and greenhouse research to understand crop responses to fertilizer and improve nutrient management. I also mentor students and help coordinate research projects.
With an M.S. in Statistics, I connect agricultural research with data analysis and statistical methods. I provide statistical consulting, supporting researchers with experimental design, data analysis, and interpretation of results. I also explore applications of artificial intelligence to research and data analysis.

title: Research & Teaching
text:
My research combines field experimentation, greenhouse studies, and statistical modeling to improve fertilizer recommendations, nutrient diagnostics, and nutrient use efficiency. I focus on nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur management in corn, soybean, wheat, and sorghum cropping systems.
I also investigate Bayesian methods, spacial statistics, and applications of artificial intelligence to analyze agricultural data, quantify uncertainty, and support agriculture management decisions.










📍 >40 site-years
Multi-location field trials across Kansas.











🧪 ¹⁵N tracers
Fertilizer N recovery in greenhouse + field.











🧮 Models
Bayesian, mixed/GAMs, ML for diagnostics & recs.











🌾 Crops
Corn, soybean, wheat, sorghum.
